verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, with local and cloud base URLs, curl examples, and API-key access to cloud models. It also offers OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints plus official Python and JavaScript libraries. Community users report embedding it in products and driving it from a Discord bot that switches models per feature. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and direct hands-on corroboration of the API endpoints themselves.
